companies.title: Companies (Domains, Slugs, or Direct ATS URLs)
companies.description: List of target companies. Supports domains (e.g. 'stripe.com', 'linear.app'), company slugs (e.g. 'airbnb'), or direct ATS board URLs (e.g. 'https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/linear'). Zero-Charge Protection: you are ONLY charged when at least 1 active job is found.

includeJobsList.title: Include Normalized Jobs List
includeJobsList.description: If enabled, includes the standardized array of job postings in each company's output record. Disable for ultra-compact GTM signal payloads (ideal for Clay / n8n webhooks).

maxJobsPerCompany.title: Max Jobs Returned Per Company
maxJobsPerCompany.description: Maximum number of individual job objects returned in the `jobs` array per company (signals and counts are always computed across ALL open roles).

detectTechStack.title: Detect B2B Tech Stack (60+ Tools)
detectTechStack.description: Scan job titles and descriptions using deterministic rules (0 LLM cost) to identify 60+ B2B SaaS, Cloud, Data, and Engineering tools.

discoverFromWebsite.title: Fallback Website /careers ATS Discovery
discoverFromWebsite.description: When direct ATS slug probing misses, fetch the company's /careers or homepage HTML to discover embedded ATS links automatically.

concurrency.title: Concurrency
concurrency.description: Number of companies processed concurrently. Higher values finish faster for large batches.
